## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall, manly youth with broad shoulders and a frank face. He has curly brown hair along with clear, straightforward hazel eyes that possess a roguish quality.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever, ambitious, and good-natured young man who has a teasing side toward girls. Known as a skilled reciter, he is kind and thoughtful, with a strong drive to get the best out of life while contributing his best in return. He is motivated to earn his own way through college and aspires to combat disease, pain, and ignorance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## History

Gilbert Blythe earned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's intense anger during afternoon lessons when he pulled her braid and called her 'Carrots,' leading to an academic rivalry despite his repeated attempts to apologize. During a dramatic recreation of Elaine, he rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from a sinking boat in his dory, though she coldly refused his offer of friendship once again. At the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) benefit concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gained her determination to succeed after spotting Gilbert in the audience. They both attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert won the graduation medal, and he subsequently surrendered the teaching position at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay near [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), allowing the pair to finally reconcile their rivalry and become close friends. Gilbert later resigned from his teaching position at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). He became a frequent visitor and collaborator with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), discussing their teaching experiences, future aspirations, and the progress of their village improvement society. Near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflected on how mature Gilbert had become, and after helping clean up following Miss Lavendar's wedding, a brief romantic spark surfaced between the two.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> ““All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship as fierce academic rivals following an incident where he teased her hair and she rejected his attempts to apologize. Though Gilbert rescued her from a sinking dory and offered his friendship, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly turned him down, leading her to privately regret her long-held grudge while continuing to compete with him for top marks. Over time, their hostility gave way to reconciliation and mutual support, with Gilbert's presence in an audience even inspiring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to overcome severe stage fright during a public performance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +33 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) shared an intense academic competition in school, which culminated in [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) winning the Avery scholarship while Gilbert earned the top medal. After completing their studies, Gilbert chose to pursue teaching rather than immediately attending college. The two later attended a wedding together, where their time spent cleaning up after the ceremony revealed hints of an emerging romantic spark between them.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_
